name: What should I do immediately after discovering water in my basement?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after discovering water in my basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: First, ensure safety by turning off electricity to the affected area if safe to do so. Then, try to identify and stop the water source if possible, such as shutting off a leaky valve. Minimize further damage by moving valuable items and furniture out of the water. Document the damage with photos or videos for insurance purposes. Contact a professional water damage repair service promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety by cutting power, stop the water source if possible, move valuables, document damage, and then call a professional service.
